description: Get the one line of code to paste on a website, with simple step-by-step instructions for WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, Webflow, plain HTML and Google Tag Manager, plus a ready message to send to your web person. Also says whether the site has started counting visitors yet, so call it again after installing to check. No cookie banner is needed. site_id is optional and defaults to your first site. Available on Hobby (free) and paid plans.

platform.description: Optional. Only return the steps for this platform.

site_id.description: Optional site UUID. Defaults to your first site. add_website returns this id.

name: get_tracking_script
title: Get the tracking code
